column1: # Every name the LINKED TempleOS/RISC-V image (build/aot/win/win_tos.blob.bin) calls but no HolyC
# unit in it defines. host/aot_link.c leaves each in a HOFYIMP1 trailer; whoever links the blob
# fills the slot. This is the port's seam, measured rather than asserted — and the only place a
# missing primitive shows up, because a dropped asm{} block is not a build failure and the C
# runtime answers for the symbol correctly.
# Pinned so that a NEW name cannot appear unnoticed, and so that implementing one forces a re-pin.
#   libm       a real gap: FP math with no HolyC or RISC-V asm body; C libm stands in
#   strmem     a real gap: a string/memory primitive that exists only as x86 asm
#   platform   the port layer ON PURPOSE — trap/IRQ/timer/task primitives the C harness owns.
#              These are what a new architecture must supply; they are not bugs.
#   x86-only   a concept with no meaning off x86; the runtime stubs it
#   MISSING    called by this image, defined in a unit this image does not include, and provided
#              by NOTHING. Calling it prints "[unresolved import]" and returns 0.
